suggested_tests: Corrupt JSON test; missing state test; reload persistence test; export/import round trip; checkpoint restore test.
do_not_touch: No rank/model/source-truth mutation. Runtime state must remain separate from frozen/rank artifacts.

suggested_tests: Event replay test; undo/remove/reassign test; backup hash continuity test; malformed event rejection test.
do_not_touch: Event log is audit/runtime only; no model training or rank updates.
